From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Veridian Health — carveout request for unbundled add-ons & custom seat mix (VP/CFO signoff required)

Team — quick background and ask: Veridian (large US regional health system) has verbally committed to a 3-year deployment (~$1.2M ARR run-rate) but their procurement is pushing to unbundle two premium add-ons (on-prem connector & enhanced SSO integration) that are normally sold only as a package. They want a different seat mix (fewer base seats + add-on seats for certain clinician types) and are requesting a 35% first-year discount to make the economics work for them.

Why this is unusual:
- Unbundling reduces our license floor and increases operational complexity for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- 35% exceeds our commercial discount guardrails for this segment.
- They want accelerated ramp (Q4 deployment) and a carveout to revenue recognition for certain service fees.

What I'm proposing (internal):
- Approve unbundling of connectors as one-off for this account with an add-on SKU.
- Cap discount at 30% (year 1 only) and tie the rest to measured adoption milestones (50% of additional concession contingent on hitting token/throughput thresholds at 6 months).
- Revenue recognition: amortize onboarding services over 12 months; license revenue recognized monthly.
- Legal to add a 90-day remediation SLA clause for the on-prem connector work and KMS/HSM confirmation.

Attachments: veridian_mam_sheet.xlsx (deal economics), proposed_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with custom seat mix).
HubSpot: https://hubspot.app/deal/8675309
Drive link (proposal): https://redwood.share/drive/veridian/proposed_SOW_v2.pdf

Request: Need VP/CFO approval to exceed standard discount caps and to permit the one-off unbundle. Would like a decision today if possible — procurement wants to table this on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Veridian Health — carveout request for unbundled add-ons & custom seat mix (VP/CFO signoff required)

Markus —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. I reviewed the MAM sheet — deal size and strategic value to our healthcare book justify a special approach, and I support unbundling as a sales motion *if* we keep the economics protected. A couple of clarifications before I sign off: 

- If we cap at 30% year‑1, document an explicit adoption milestone schedule tied to the remaining 5% to be released at month 6 and month 12.
- Confirm that add-on SKUs will carry a higher implementation fee that is non-refundable and recognized over 12 months (to protect ARR).
- Need legal to confirm the remedial SLA doesn't create open-ended O&M responsibilities.

I'm comfortable endorsing this for escalation to Rishi (CFO) with those conditions. Recommend marking the HubSpot deal with "exec-review: veridian-unbundle" and flagging renewal triggers.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Folks — adding procurement/legal perspective.

- We need the security questionnaire completed for the on-prem connector. I've started filling it and attached the partial file (sec_questionnaire_filled.pdf). They will insist on KMS integration and a data-retention carveout. If we're granting the unbundle, confirm that the customer retains responsibility for local storage and we are limited to transient KV caches.
- For revenue recognition and billing: if we accept non-standard seat mix, billing needs a deterministic per-seat SKU and a cap on seat variance to avoid messy true-ups. Recommend 30% maximum variance year-over-year with an option to true-up at renewal.
- Legal: make the custom SOW clause explicitly time-boxed to this contract only — we should not create precedent language in the master terms.

If Procurement at Veridian signs up to the SLA boundary and KMS terms, I'm okay moving this to Rishi for financial signoff.

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Markus / team —

Thanks for the clear packet and the suggested guardrails. I reviewed the economics and the risk mitigations (SLA, adoption milestones, revenue scheduling). I will APPROVE the exception with the following binding conditions: 

1) Discount cap for year 1 set at 30% fixed. Any further concessions must be tied to predefined adoption milestones (documented and measurable) and require joint sign-off by Sales and Commercial Ops.
2) Onboarding and integration fees to be invoiced up-front and recognized over 12 months; license revenue recognized monthly. No one-time concessionals to be recognized as ARR.
3) Legal to insert clause: carveout applies only to this deal (non-precedential) and includes a 90-day remediation SLA plus KMS/HSM compliance confirmation.
4) Procurement must sign the amended SOW and complete the security questionnaire before countersignature.

Markus: you have greenlight to proceed to countersignature once Legal confirms the SOW language and Procurement returns the completed security questionnaire. Please update HubSpot (DEAL-2026-1198-VER) with the final approval status and attach the signed SOW.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer (acting CFO oversight) | Redwood Inference
